newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ALPINE SKIING-WOMEN'S GIANT SLALOM MOVED TO GERMANY.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-WOMEN'S GIANT SLALOM MOVED TO GERMANY.

text.p: A women's World Cup giant slalom called off on Friday because of too much snow has been rescheduled for January 17 in Zwiesel, Germany, Alpine skiing officials said.
The race, originally set for Val d'Isere, France, will be the first of back-to-back giant slaloms at the German resort ahead of the already scheduled race on January 18 and a slalom on January 19.

Organisers at Val d'Isere called off their giant slalom because of heavy snow on Friday morning. They also cancelled a men's downhill practice scheduled for later on Friday, ahead of a race planned for Saturday.
The season's opening men's downhill, in Whistler, British Columbia, was called off last week because of similar weather and was rescheduled for Val Gardena, Italy, on December 20.
